title: The Morning Jason Njoku Switched Off iROKOtv's Free Service
conflicts: Audience: Njoku's blog gives >400,000 monthly uniques for the 140 countries; ITWeb 1 million monthly uniques overall; AFP nearly a million hits a month; Business Daily 500,000+ registered users. Story uses the blog's figure. YouTube revenue share: ~12% by April 2014 (blog) vs 14.1% in H1 2013 (Techzim); different periods, story uses only the 2011 starting point (100%). Price: $5 (blog) vs $7.99 a month (AFP, Business Daily); story gives no price.
notes: Episode moved from the slate's 2011 YouTube exit to the April 2014 'Killing iROKOtv' decision, which completes that shift and is documented by Njoku's own blog post (read via a Wayback Machine capture, since jason.com.ng no longer resolves) plus same-week reporting. The 2010-12 YouTube story is background. No reliable later subscriber or profit figures were found, so none are claimed.
